facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Capital Type: No Guaranteed Capital; separate AppWorks fund discussion
facts_raw.Funding / Support: Free accelerator; AppWorks fund may invest separately based on company needs/fit
facts_raw.Funding Trigger: Separate fundraising/investment discussion; joining accelerator does not guarantee funding
facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: 0% accelerator equity; no rent/service fee; no token/options/revenue/profit-sharing compensation
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Founder-driven application; no revenue requirement; seed through later-stage companies can apply. Current RFS themes are signals, not hard restrictions.
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 全职创始团队；清晰 founder-market fit；可演示产品/MVP；真实用户/客户验证；明确下一阶段里程碑与融资用途。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: Online/offline flexible; in-person participation in Taiwan encouraged but not mandatory in every activity.
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: Can assist admitted international founders with Taiwan Gold Card / Entrepreneur Visa applications.
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官方申请入口优先；若官网未公开联系人，不建议猜测个人联系方式。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: AI / AI-native；Crypto / Web3；阶段以 Early stage 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司；纯线下传统业务、缺乏可规模化技术产品
